findings.text: blocking: the manifest, its baseline_suite and its after_suite all record the fence-arm logs as <run-dir>/baseline-arm.log and <run-dir>/head-arm.log, and neither file exists there; the worker wrote them to node-local /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261112T053103325903-batch-entry-carries-review-waiver/ (where both are still readable: 51 passed EXIT=0 and 55 passed EXIT=0), so the promotion receipt's log_path cannot be opened and a reader elsewhere on the workstation cannot see the gate at all.

non-blocking: the waived case asserts queue_admission._plan_review_owed returns None rather than running an admission pass, so the done_when's 'the waived entry launches' is exercised only through the gate predicate - a regression that drops the predicate call at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:5524 would leave every assertion in this file green.

non-blocking: the boolean guard added for allow_unreviewed_plan has no test that reddens without it; removing :479-482 leaves all four cases in tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_waivers.py green, so the refusal it adds is unguarded.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 6fd868ab8a: 9aa4025058 adds the field to BATCH_ENTRY_FIELDS, a boolean check at :479, the pass-through at :749, the queue_requests parameter and dispatch_options stamp at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:307-395, and the 261-line test file; ad8f34b7d adds only the 41-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a new four-case test with a temporary plan and crew home; tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_waivers.py:178 asserts the pointer records the waiver, :213-216 assert the enforced gate holds the unwaived entry and owes the waived one nothing, :237-238 assert the misspelt field is refused by name, and the declared negative control reddens the two waiver cases; the arm receipts the manifest cites are as recorded in its suite fields, but their log paths do not resolve.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a batch entry may set allow_unreviewed_plan with the single-dispatch flag's effect and recorded waiver; reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:57 accepts the field, :749 hands it to reckon/crew/dispatch.py:392, which records it on dispatch_options that reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:5301 reads before holding a request.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 9aa4025058 and ad8f34b7d, changed_paths the four landed files, tests the fence pytest command, baseline_suite and after_suite both completed with zero failures, and negative_control_log naming a log whose content matches its note; its head-arm.log and baseline-arm.log paths do not resolve.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's fence was reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_waivers.py and the evidence fragment; git diff 6fd868ab8a..ad8f34b7d touches exactly those four and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_waivers.py:178 fails if the dispatch_options stamping is reverted and :216 fails if the gate ignores the waiver, and the declared negative control removes the field from BATCH_ENTRY_FIELDS to redden two cases; the boolean guard added at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:479 has no test that reddens without it.
justifications.evidence: the fence-arm logs the manifest records are absent from the run directory and readable only from node-local scratch (head-arm.log reading 55 passed EXIT=0, baseline-arm.log reading 51 passed EXIT=0), while negative-control.log is intact at 2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1 naming the unknown field.
justifications.fit: the added code follows the surrounding style of reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:747-756 and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid, and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:308-315 documents the mechanism rather than the task.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:749 passes the entry's allow_unreviewed_plan to reckon/crew/dispatch.py:392, which stamps it on the stored request's dispatch_options, the field reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:5301 reads before holding a request on the review gate, which is the effect the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing waiver carrier reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:555 _CARRIED_OPTION_KEYS and the existing reader at :5301, adding no second mechanism for carrying dispatch options; a search of reckon/crew found no other owner of a batch-entry waiver field.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 6fd868ab8a..ad8f34b7d lists only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py, tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_waivers.py and the evidence fragment, every one inside the node's declared write paths.
